page.overview:
Who is Ashann?

is a gnome sorcerer working for the Consortium of the Vermilion Dream.

Occult extollants like Ashann typically have a thirst for knowledge that drives them into risky investigations of ancient lore. Like other female members of the Consortium who are not infiltrating other organizations, Ashann wears red robes and a floppy red hat, similar to the hat Master Vrill wears to shield herself from the sun.

Ashann is highly motivated to acquire a fenced ruidium shortsword, to the point that she will attack anyone who outbids her for it. On the other hand, if someone tries to take it from her after she's already purchased it, she prefers to flee, and will only fight if caught. In any case, if she's badly hurt, she will surrender.

By the time of the crisis around the Netherdeep in 836 PD, Ashann is among the middle ranks of the Consortium, and she is sent to Old Man Kruuk, who fences stolen goods out of a bakery that he uses as a front. If the Player Characters in Call of the Netherdeep attempt to join the Cobalt Soul after arriving in Ank'Harel, one of their early missions to gain membership requires that they prove that Kruuk is illegally selling dangerous magic items and confiscate said items, and it is on this mission that they may encounter Ashann, who has an appointment to meet after the bakery closes for the evening to purchase a ruidium shortsword.
